findings: ADVISORY: releaseExpiredHolds partial-release on error — the loop has no per-iteration error isolation; a single inventory failure leaves all subsequent expired holds unreleased. Wrap each booking in try/catch.
ADVISORY: Build log empty — the captured build output contains only the nest build invocation with no compiler output; TypeScript error count is unverifiable.
ADVISORY: getBookingById hotel staff gap — access check allows hotel owner but not active hotel staff, creating an asymmetry with getHotelBookings.
ADVISORY: PAYMENT_PENDING cancellation has no inventory release; currently unexploitable but implicit dependency on confirmBooking being the only path to that status.
